correctness.rationale: Exact face classification by unique common base neighbor for multisupport sets and by neighbor-fiber sum for single-support sets. The resulting fixed-simplex good cover has an explicit nerve; each E-only face of size at least two has a unique adjoining V-center and yields a descending-size elementary free-face collapse to the weighted double-cover graph. Functorial good-cover nerve theorem gives natural persistence equivalence. Integral graph cycle sublattices are primitive under inclusions. Independently enumerated 1,481 threshold stages across 339 square-free graph instances have matching mod-two Betti numbers, including two large named graph examples; square obstruction correctly disagrees. Finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Transforms an arbitrary-dimensional, variable-density multineighbor filtration of heterogeneous independent graph blowups into a completely explicit weighted graph filtration for all C4-free bases, preserving every integral homology map, including components and primitive cycle births. It rules out higher homology and torsion, gives graph-algorithmic barcodes for arbitrary weights, and exhibits multiple distinct H1 birth thresholds on a natural two-triangle base. Four-cycles give a sharp structural boundary. This solves a natural topology-of-density filtration problem for a wide input class, not a finite recomputation or a mere ordinary-neighborhood corollary.
